You put the berries and mascarpone in a blender, and your done :)

Pro's:

  • The berries instantly freeze the mascarpone, so the whole process takes less them 5 minutes.

  • Both the mascarpone and small fruits like berries are low in carbs.

  • Easy and fun for kids

Cons:

  • You cant make a big batch and store it in the freezer, deep freezing the mascarpone ruins it.

  • Its a semi solid recipe, so you have to eat it within 10 minutes or so. (remember you cant store it, so if it melts you have to make a new one)
